subject: Approval needed: comp exception for Riley Huang 1 (inference infra lead)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Riley Huang 1 comp exception request

Rishi 3,

Quick summary: Interview loop completed last week. Hiring manager recommended a Level 6 (L6) offer but candidate market comps sit at the top of our published L6 band. The recruiter is requesting the following package to close:

- Title: Inference Infrastructure Lead (L6)
- Base: $240,000 (posted band midpoint $220k)
- Bonus: 15% target
- Equity: 0.25% RSU over 4 years
- Sign-on: $40,000 (to cover deferred comp)
- Start: Nov 2, 2026

This exceeds standard delegated authority for the hiring team (sign-on >$30k and base > band midpoint need VP/Finance/headcount sign-off). Attached are candidate notes and comps (riley_offer_notes.pdf, comp-justification.docx).

Can you advise on stakeholder approvals required? I suggest Lauren approve the sign-on and base exception, Mina confirm runway, Marcos to confirm if we can flex equity, and you to approve final exception as reasonable given market difficulty filling senior inference roles.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
+1 650-555-0112
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Riley Huang 1 comp exception request

Thanks Aditya.

I agree this candidate is strategic for the inference roadmap and have a bias to close. A few comments:

- Base $240k looks high but still within range for L6 in high-cost markets. If we do that, let's reduce sign-on to $30k and increase equity to 0.30% to align long-term incentives.
- We need explicit VP approval for sign-on >$30k; Lauren, can you weigh in?
- Mina: confirm whether shifting allocation to equity (0.30%) is ok for the next two fiscal quarters.
- Markus: please confirm whether the hiring manager can endorse the updated mix (base vs equity).

If all align, I'll greenlight and cover the final approval to proceed to offer.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Talent Ops
